title: Zesty Buttery Egyptian Cabbage Stew
description: A comforting and flavorful Egyptian stew featuring hispi sweetheart cabbage, perfect for a sick day. This dish is made with a combination of buttery and zesty flavors.
instructions: Melt 2 tablespoons of butter in a large cazuela over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the chopped cabbage, salt, and black pepper, and cook until the cabbage is slightly wilted.
Add the kombu cold extract, lemon juice, and remaining 2 tablespoons of butter, and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes, or until the cabbage is tender.
Serve hot, garnished with additional lemon juice if desired.
